title: BigCommerce Review (2026)
intro: BigCommerce is evaluated here as a hosted SaaS ecommerce platform — BigCommerce is a hosted ecommerce platform emphasizing open SaaS — no transaction fee on platform billing when using eligible gateways, multi-storefront options, and API extensibility. 2026 plan rename: Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($299), Performance from $1,499/mo annual. GMV caps trigger upgrades; open payment provider fees up to 2.0% on third-party gateways for self-serve tiers (verify live terms). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s Ecommerce methodology (ease of use, storefront/commerce fit, catalog & order depth, checkout conversion, integrations, omnichannel/POS, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose BigCommerce when you want a Shopify-class hosted platform with open architecture and multi-storefront headroom — and you will model GMV thresholds and payment fees explicitly.
verdict: Choose BigCommerce when you want a Shopify-class hosted platform with open architecture and multi-storefront headroom — and you will model GMV thresholds and payment fees explicitly. Consider Shopify for ecosystem/POS depth; WooCommerce for open-source control; Square Online for retail-led omnichannel. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
